name: ice.domains Free DNS Hosting
free_limit: Vendor-hosted authoritative Anycast DNS, free forever with unlimited DNS zones, records and queries; DNSSEC, REST API, DNS analytics and DDoS protection included; works with domains from any registrar.
watch_out: Requires an existing domain registration (domain registration/renewal is not free). Users must change nameservers at their registrar. Extraordinary query traffic should be discussed with provider; no formal SLA or contractual no-charge guarantee was independently established. Vendor claims production and small-business suitability.
